reviews.name: Sample customer
reviews.text: Wore it to the office. Nobody said a word. Several people stood up straighter.

reviews.name: Sample customer
reviews.text: The skull has better manners than most of my colleagues.

reviews.name: Sample customer
reviews.text: From across the road it is a target. Up close it is the brand name, over and over. I like a shirt with a second look in it.

reviews.name: Sample customer
reviews.text: Bought it for the roundel. Spent the bus ride reading the rings.

reviews.name: Sample customer
reviews.text: Four letters, then four more. It says what I would have said, only shorter.

reviews.name: Sample customer
reviews.text: Put it on the morning of a difficult meeting. The meeting lost.
